svg.title: Portal container rollout and recovery gates
svg.desc: The embedding guide provides a complete text walkthrough of this flow.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Deploy uses exact successful CI head SHA

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Install and verify reviewed deploy script
Apply allowlisted additive migrations

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Refresh environment; pull SHA-tagged image
Start candidate container

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Release fails before container switch
Inspect completed preparation steps

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Expected running image
and container healthy?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Record last-good SHA
Request CDN invalidation: best effort

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SSM terminal Success
Deploy job accepts release

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Start previous image
Keep additive migrations installed

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Prior image healthy
Rejected release still fails
